name: cps_loop_fault
description: Four-node cyber-physical system with monitoring cycle A_Sensor -> B_Controller -> C_Actuator -> D_Monitor -> A_Sensor. Diagnostic claim 'fault_origin = B_Controller' cannot be warranted: the observation map collapses two internal fault states of B_Controller (B_fault_1 and B_fault_2), leaving a non-zero cyclic obstruction.

diagnostic_claim.description: The root cause of the observed fault is the B_Controller subsystem.

observation_note: Observation map M collapses fault states B_fault_1 and B_fault_2 in B_Controller. Available sensors at the A_Sensor-B_Controller and B_Controller-C_Actuator interfaces cannot distinguish these states.
